title: Privacy Notice | Garage Doors Milton Keynes
meta: Privacy notice for Garage Doors Milton Keynes: what personal data our enquiry form collects, why we use it, how long we keep it and your UK GDPR rights.
hero_sub: How we collect, use and protect the personal information you share when you contact us or request a quote.
summary: How we handle personal data from enquiries and quote requests, and your rights under UK data protection law.
body:
This privacy notice explains how Garage Doors Milton Keynes ("we", "us") collects and uses personal information when you use this website or send us an enquiry. We are committed to handling your data fairly and in line with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018.

Who is responsible for your data

The data controller is Garage Doors Milton Keynes. If you have any questions about this notice or how we handle your information, contact us at the details on our contact page or through our contact page.

What information we collect

When you fill in our enquiry or quote form, call us or email us, we may collect:

  • Your name
  • Your phone number and email address
  • Your address or postcode
  • Details of your enquiry, such as door type, size and the work you need
  • Any photos you choose to send us

Our website may also collect limited technical information, such as your IP address and browser type, through server logs and any cookies we use. This website uses only the essential cookies needed for it to work. If we add website analytics in future, we will update this notice and, where required, ask for your consent first.

Why we use your information

We use your information to:

  • Respond to your enquiry and provide a quote
  • Arrange surveys, repairs or installations
  • Carry out any work you agree to and handle related guarantee or aftercare queries
  • Keep records we are legally required to keep

Our lawful basis is either taking steps at your request before entering into a contract, performing a contract with you, our legitimate interest in responding to enquiries and running our business, or complying with legal obligations. We will not send you marketing unless you have agreed to it, and you can opt out at any time.

Who we share it with

We do not sell your personal information. We may share it only where needed with trusted parties who help us provide our service, such as the fitter or engineer carrying out your job, our website and email providers, and our accountants, or where the law requires it. Anyone we share data with must keep it secure.

How long we keep it

If you make an enquiry but do not go ahead, we keep your details for up to 12 months and then delete them. If we carry out work for you, we keep relevant records for up to 6 years after the job for guarantee, accounting and legal purposes.

Your rights

Under UK data protection law you have the right to:

  • Ask for a copy of the personal information we hold about you
  • Ask us to correct inaccurate information
  • Ask us to delete your information, where we have no legal reason to keep it
  • Object to or ask us to restrict how we use your information
  • Ask for your information to be transferred to another organisation, where applicable
  • Withdraw consent at any time, where we rely on consent

To use any of these rights, contact us at the details on our contact page. We will respond within one month.

Complaints

If you are unhappy with how we have handled your information, please contact us first so we can try to put it right. You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO), the UK's data protection regulator, at ico.org.uk.

Changes to this notice

We may update this notice from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page. Last updated: October 2026.
